title: Ado Hub AutoFarm OP
features:
This script was made by me for Cut Grass for Brainrots and is meant to make farming way easier and smoother.
The script has the following features:

Auto Swing
Automatically swings for you.

Auto Collect Money
Collects money from your stands automatically.

Auto Brainrot Collector
Walks to brainrots in your selected zone and picks them up for you.
(Uses walking/pathfinding instead of just instantly teleporting for the farm itself.)

Auto Upgrades
Automatically buys:

Health (+100)

Health (+1000)

Carry (+1)

Speed (+1)

Auto Buy Cutters
Automatically buys all available cutters for you.

Teleports
Lets you teleport to zones or straight back to your base whenever you want.

Player Features
Includes:

WalkSpeed changer

Noclip

Anti-AFK

Keys last for 5 hours!
